_comment: Currency definitions built by verusd 1.2.17-2 on VRSCTEST, 2026-07-29. definecurrency returns {tx, hex} and does NOT broadcast — no txid comes back and the mempool stays empty — so the whole matrix cost nothing beyond funding one identity. Re-capture with fixtures/daemon/README-currency.md.
_covers: every non-PBaaS option combination: TOKEN alone and combined with FRACTIONAL, IDRESTRICTED, IDSTAKING, IDREFERRALS and IDREFERRALSREQUIRED, across proofprotocol 1 and 2, plus start/end block, preallocations, multiple reserves and preconversion limits.

_structure._eval_note: EVAL_CURRENCY_DEFINITION. The output frame is the usual PUSH(master) OP_CHECKCRYPTOCONDITION PUSH(params) OP_DROP, and the destination is a 33-byte PUBLIC KEY rather than a key hash — unlike every other CryptoCondition this SDK builds.
launch_transaction_outputs: identityprimary — the named identity, restated with its ACTIVE_CURRENCY flag set
reservedeposit — carries the 100.0 currency import fee
_structure._launch_note: A launch is SEVEN outputs, not one. The definition is the part that varies per permutation; the other five are notarization bootstrap that this SDK does not yet build.

_payload_layout_so_far.4: options (u32 LE) — the bit field the permutations vary
_payload_layout_so_far.startblock: VARINT — the Satoshi form, same as reserve transfers
_payload_layout_so_far._incomplete: STILL NOT mapped: the 22 bytes between proofprotocol and startblock, the identity of the three 8-byte lists that follow the weights (minpreconversion, maxpreconversion and initialcontributions are the candidates, all zero in these vectors so they cannot be told apart yet), and preallocations. A field-by-field parser drifts on the fractional vectors, so the layout above is NOT yet sufficient to encode one.

_resolved_2026_07_29.weights: 4-byte LITTLE-ENDIAN, not VARINT. Settled with asymmetric weights so the two readings could not be confused: 0.25 and 0.75 appear as 40787d01 and c0687804 (LE32), and their LE64 forms are absent from the payload entirely.
_resolved_2026_07_29._why_it_matters: Amounts in this codebase are otherwise the Satoshi VARINT — reserve transfers, the fee fields in this same object. A currency definition mixes both: VARINT for the block heights and fee fields, little-endian for the reserve arithmetic. Assuming one form throughout produces wrong money.
_resolved_2026_07_29.vector_shape: each list is compactSize(count) then count fixed-width elements: currencies are 20 bytes each, weights 4, and the three lists after them 8 each. A three-reserve vector confirms it: 03 then three ids, 03 then 002d3101 80c3c901 80f0fa02 = 0.2/0.3/0.5.
